reusable_covariate_goals.prompt: Covariates in the design formula (batch, pairing/donor, sex) are declared from the experimental design; do not select them by testing their association with expression.
A batch-corrected matrix is for visualisation or downstream scoring only; differential analysis models the batch in the design instead (ENGINEERING_PLAN sva-batch rule).
Surrogate variables added to a design must be reported with their number and the estimation method.
Condition comparisons in single-cell data are made at the biological-sample level (pseudobulk or proportion models); cells are not independent replicates.
